noData: No reading yet. Open this screen aboard, on the boat's Wi-Fi, to start collecting.

error.mixed_content: The browser blocks http:// addresses from this secure page. Use an https:// address, or let the FleetAi plugin send the data.
error.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check that this device is on the boat's Wi-Fi.
error.unauthorized: The server requires a token. Ask an administrator to enter a read-only token.
error.tls: The secure connection failed. The server's certificate is probably not trusted by this device.
error.protocol: The server does not answer like a Signal K server. Check its address.

banner.pluginOnly: Read by the plugin: no live gauges from this browser
banner.screenOpen: Collecting while this screen stays open.

empty.title: No instruments connected
empty.manage: Register the boat's Signal K server to read its engines, batteries, tanks and sensors here.
empty.readOnly: No Signal K server is registered for this boat. Ask an administrator to connect it.

form.title: Signal K server
form.baseUrlHint: Origin only, e.g. https://signalk.local:3443 — no path or credentials.
form.tokenHint: Optional. A read-only token if the server requires one.
form.tokenSet: A token is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
form.vesselContextHint: Leave vessels.self unless the server says otherwise.
form.removeMessage: The readings already collected for this boat are deleted with it.

history.title: History
history.noPaths: No numeric reading to plot yet.
history.pick: Pick up to {max} readings to plot.
history.selectOne: Select a reading to see its history.

editor.title: Alert rules
editor.description: Built-in rules (battery, engine temperature, shallow water, Signal K alarms) are always on. Add your own thresholds below.
editor.hysteresisHint: The alert only clears once the value is back beyond this margin.

plugin.title: Signal K plugin
plugin.description: For a boat with no screen on, the plugin installed on the Signal K server pushes readings to FleetAi itself, with a token specific to this boat.
plugin.tokenOnce: Copy this token now: it will not be shown again.
plugin.status: A token has been active since {date}.
plugin.rotateMessage: The old token stops working immediately: the plugin will need to be reconfigured.
plugin.revokeMessage: The plugin can no longer send readings until a new token is generated.

ais.title: Nearby AIS vessels
ais.live: Targets received live from the Signal K server, refreshed every 5 seconds.
ais.lastKnown: Last recorded sightings (past 30 minutes). Open this screen aboard for the live view.
ais.mapLabel: Map of AIS vessels around the boat

forecast.title: Weather forecast
forecast.stale: Forecast is out of date (fetched {date}). Reconnect to the boat Wi-Fi to refresh it.
forecast.empty: The server provides no data for this period.

error.no_position: Boat position unknown: the forecast loads as soon as it is received.
error.unsupported: This Signal K server does not expose the weather API (version 2 required).
error.no_provider: No weather provider is installed on the Signal K server (for example Open-Meteo).
error.unauthorized: The server refuses access to the forecast: check the source token.
error.unreachable: Signal K server unreachable: the last known forecast stays displayed.
error.invalid: The weather provider answered without a usable forecast.

setup.title: Connect my boat
setup.subtitle: A few steps to see your boat's engines, batteries and position.

hardware.guide: See the kits and the install guide

none.title: Nothing yet
none.desc: No onboard server: the guide tells you what to buy.

cerbo.title: A Cerbo GX (Victron)
cerbo.desc: Signal K is enabled there with a few settings.

signalk.title: A Signal K server
signalk.desc: OpenPlotter, Raspberry Pi or other: already installed.

plugin.title: Plugin (recommended)
plugin.desc: The onboard server pushes the readings to FleetAi itself, even with no screen on.
plugin.limit: One command to paste on the onboard server.

app.title: App on board
app.desc: This app, open on the boat's Wi-Fi, reads the server and forwards the readings.
app.limit: Only collects while the screen stays open.

plugin.addressHint: Useful if you later switch to direct reading from the app. Leave empty to use a default address.
plugin.commandIntro: In a terminal on the onboard server, logged in as the user running Signal K, paste this command:
plugin.tokenLost: The token is only shown once. To get the full command again, generate a new token (the old one will stop working).
plugin.manualTitle: Install by hand from the Appstore
plugin.manualBody: In the Signal K admin, open Appstore, search for the signalk-fleetai plugin, install it, then enter the FleetAi address and the token in its configuration.

browser.securityNote: Use a read-only token: the app never needs to write to the server.
browser.readOnlyNote: Create a read-only account for it in Signal K security.
browser.httpsNote: From this secure site, an http:// address is blocked by the browser: prefer https://.

invalid_url.title: Invalid address.
invalid_url.fix: Enter a full origin, for example http://openplotter.local:3000.

mixed_content.title: Address blocked by the browser.
mixed_content.fix: This page is secure: use an https:// address, or choose the Plugin path.

unreachable.title: Server unreachable.
unreachable.fix: Check that this device is on the boat's Wi-Fi and that the address and port are correct.

unauthorized.title: Access denied.
unauthorized.fix: The server requires a token: enter a read-only token.

tls.title: Secure connection refused.
tls.fix: This device does not trust the server certificate: open the address once in the browser to accept it.

protocol.title: This is not a Signal K server.
protocol.fix: Check the address and port (3000 by default, 3443 over HTTPS).

waiting.waiting: Waiting for the plugin's first batch… This page refreshes by itself.
waiting.received: First batch received: the plugin works.

causes.network: The onboard server has no Internet access.
causes.token: The token was mis-copied or regenerated since: generate a new one.
causes.restart: Signal K was not restarted after the install.
causes.node: The command failed: re-read its output in the terminal.

engines.none: No engine is registered on this boat: you can skip this step.
engines.intro: Match each FleetAi engine with the identifier detected on the server.
engines.noneDetected: No engine detected yet. You can link them later.

done.readings: {count, plural, one {# reading received.} other {# readings received.}}
done.rules: The built-in alert rules (temperature, oil pressure, batteries…) are active.
